head: Instagram Edits app now on iPad, free with a bigger timeline
dek: Instagram's Edits video editor now runs on iPad with more room for the timeline and tools, two weeks after it came to Mac. It's free on the App Store, with in-app purchases, and needs iPadOS 16.3 or later.
details: The same update, version 457.0, lets you trim a clip before adding it, keeps generating captions while you edit, adds three filters and, in Labs, imports .cube LUT files and converts log footage. Instagram's post also says a Threads app made for iPad is coming soon, without a date.
means: If you cut Reels on your iPhone, you can now edit them in Edits on the larger iPad screen.
todo: Download or update Edits from the App Store on your iPad and sign in with your Instagram account.
